description: NaNdTi₂O₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.93 Å. Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.78 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-24°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.01 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms.
